result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it structurally easier for people to trust one another.

Not naive trust. Not forced harmony. But the kind of trust that lets a stranger tell the truth without fear, lets a scientist admit uncertainty without being destroyed, and lets two people with opposite views actually listen instead of just waiting to speak.

So much of the world’s worst suffering comes from, breakdown — from people hoarding power, hiding information, or assuming the worst of each other. If trust were cheaper, cooperation would become more natural, and a huge share of our problems would start to shrink on their own.

That’s what I’d change.
